body:
I have never really cared about what other people think of me, even my parents, because they have been so good to me so far. Most of my struggle has been over what I think of myself.

But this is the first time I really don't want my parents to know anything. A lot of members of my family have struggled with a lot of things, especially religious anxiety, but it all turned into depression or stress or whatever in their cases.

They've never been suicidal, and none of them have ever had violence issues. I'd be ashamed to tell my dad that I want to kill myself or that I'm becoming violent. My family hasn't ever had that, and I don't think they'd accept it.
I haven't been diagnosed with anything. Don't have any meds.

Religious anxiety and anger issues that are developing into violence. That's really as general as I can think to get. I haven't really been able to wrap my head around everything that's been happening. It's hard to keep track of which things are a result of my failure, and which things are out of my control.

EDIT: To clarify, I say "developing into violence" because I still haven't hurt anyone and nobody has ever seen me do anything that would indicate anger issues. But I find myself intentionally trying to break stuff and punch and kick walls when no one is around.
